column2: std::atomic (hud_tape_ctru.cpp, Alpha 15): written by the drawing side when the HUD tape becomes valid or is dropped (publishedPicture before publishedValid's release store), read by the game thread to choose a queued replay or recording (acquire load); the tape itself is never read there

std::atomic (screen_tape_ctru.cpp, Alpha 15): counts of queued retained-screen replays the drawing side ran or refused; the game thread reads jobRefusals (acquire) to drop every recording after a refusal

the main surface (handle, extent): written only on the game thread, by initializeFramebuffers at start and by configureMainFramebufferSynced after settle(); configureMainFramebuffer's fast path (Alpha 15) only reads it there, comparing the size the game commits again at every draw phase's end; the drawing side only reads it (bloom job, main target)

the retained-screen recording in progress: written only by the synced begin and end on the game thread (beginSynced/endSynced, after syncGxWorker); duskScreenTapeBegin's queued path (Alpha 15) only reads `active`, and only while no recording is open (a recording suspends the queued runs, so the synced path is taken); the worker reads `active` and writes `volatileTexture` only while one is open (duskScreenTapeVolatileTexture)
std::atomic: whether the last bloom pass drew (a pass is queued only after one did), as casterPassProven

the open conditional section's answer, drawing-side state that moves with the queue like the bank copy: written by the thread that consumes records (the worker, or the game thread inside a sync); deferNativeRun and nativeSection touch it on the game thread only right after gxworker::sync(), whose park handshake (acquire) makes the worker's write visible and leaves nothing queued
SD switch (gx-palette-fast-off.txt) set once at start before the worker thread is created; only read afterwards

merged skin lists, drawing side (gx_command_draw.cpp): written only by whichever thread has the GPU (drawGxCommand on the list processor, drawQueuedShape, nativeReplay), one at a time like the record tables; refused/batches are set and read inside one drawQueuedShape call; the game thread only reads the counters for its report line every 300 pictures (duskNativeSkinDrawReport): a count one draw late at worst
